verification.reproductionScript:
import sys
import warnings
import sqlalchemy as sa
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker
import dao

warnings.simplefilter('error', sa.exc.LegacyAPIWarning)
Base = declarative_base()
class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'users'
    id = sa.Column(sa.Integer, primary_key=True)

engine = sa.create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:')
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
sess = Session()

try:
    dao.get_user_by_id(sess, User, 42)
    sys.exit(0)
except sa.exc.LegacyAPIWarning as e:
    sys.stderr.write(f'LegacyAPIWarning: {e}\n')
    sys.exit(1)
except Exception as e:
    sys.stderr.write(f'Error: {e}\n')
    sys.exit(1)
verification.testSuite:
import sys
import sqlalchemy as sa
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker
import dao

Base = declarative_base()
class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'users'
    id = sa.Column(sa.Integer, primary_key=True)

engine = sa.create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:')
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
sess = Session()
user = User(id=42)
sess.add(user)
sess.commit()

res = dao.get_user_by_id(sess, User, 42)
assert res is not None and res.id == 42
print('VERIFICATION_SUCCESS_STAGE_3')
sys.exit(0)
